  <p class="post-meta">Gemini Summary: 9:25PM</p>


<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Inflation and Policy:</strong> June retail inflation rose to 4.38%, breaching the RBI’s 4% target for the first time in 16 months, with analysts projecting an average of 5.1% for FY27 and potential for future rate hikes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Sell-off:</strong> The Sensex dropped 561 points and the Nifty slipped below 24,100 as surging Brent crude prices and escalating US-Iran tensions dampened investor sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory Update:</strong> The Supreme Court upheld a SEBI penalty of ₹2.1 crore against Kotak AMC and its executives regarding past debt fund management rules.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE9wbnBCaDIxS0xCcU44SGc0cElLbjV5VzhQMlY1ZVJLcHBZZElqZVVZU1ZrLXBKcURPRUVjNTBNaFl5eXg2ZkRESEhfZnNIQVd6SmN6TGR5UUFDTktDdWlMcThGd0YzWnh4Vlo2SEd2YnpzSnNmTEgxUmxYX0U?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency and Bond Yields:</strong> The Indian rupee weakened past 96/USD to a one-month low, while the 10-year bond yield climbed to 6.77% as markets reacted to the sharp rally in global crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQS0pINE55cXptNVVJOWQ2eDJUYTZvVjFCTEVDSlJZSi1rNmZpUG56aVMxc2M3dDZta0ZaVG9NenJwTkpjLUVsY1pYSE1Oc0w3RWRtUlVvaThQU1hPcFlQbkM3V1lhLUg5a1k4dWVienFuOEFHd3VLcHdhdWpOUzhfUV83VGc1a3FjUzNOR1pqYmx2UEJiamh2S3daWG5OckN5Qi1KSkNlWlk?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
